fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION... Low humidities and occasional gusty winds continue to make some very localized critical fire weather conditions and the same is expected again tomorrow. Coverage will be too low to issue any products. Moisture is still expected to move in towards the end of the week heading into the weekend keeping critical fire weather conditions at bay. ...GUSTY ERRATIC WINDS CAN BE EXPECTED NEAR
